delete_routine_log writes an absent-row tombstone before applying revision ordering
entitlement boundary revokes direct tracker access and replaces RPC signatures

before.title: recognizes a same-origin followed pricing redirect
coalesces rapid updates and never runs more than one save
retains updates for two dates and saves them serially
an older success cannot mark a newer revision saved
retries retryable failures once before surfacing an error
does not retry a non-retryable validation failure
manual retry reuses the failed revision and can recover
flush bypasses the trailing debounce and idle fires once
dismissing an invalid custom draft restores the latest valid snapshot after an in-flight save
a dispatched date can receive a higher-revision tombstone when no valid snapshot remains
superseding during retry backoff prevents the obsolete retry
